class.name: NetwAction
class.brief_description: A predicted discrete action bound to one authority method.

method.name: request
method.description:
Asks the server to run the action at [param view_tick]. Every argument after [param view_tick] reaches that method in the order it was written, after the [NetwActionContext] the method always takes first. [codeblock] place_bomb.request(tick, position, fuse)
func _place_bomb(ctx: NetwActionContext, pos: Vector2, fuse: float) -> void: [/codeblock] On the peer controlling the entity, [member predict] runs immediately. On any other peer the call does nothing. [b]Player request.[/b]

members.member: Called with the [Node] [member predict] returned when the server accepted the action. Unset, that node is freed with [method Node.queue_free].
Shows the action locally and returns a [Node], usually a placeholder, that [member confirm] or [member revert] later receives.
Called with the [Node] [member predict] returned when the server denied the action or did not answer in time. Unset, that node is freed with [method Node.queue_free].
How many ticks to wait for the server before reverting. [code]0[/code] waits 120 ticks.
When the server runs the action.

signal.name: confirmed
signal.description: Emitted when the server accepted the action.

signal.name: denied
signal.description: Emitted when the server denied the action or did not answer in time.

constants.constant: Runs on the server when its tick reaches [member NetwActionContext.view_tick].

Runs on the server once it has recorded the requesting entity's state at [member NetwActionContext.view_tick], so the action sees the same state the client saw. Other peers see the result later. Read other entities with [method Netw.sample].
Runs as soon as the request reaches the server.
